## Notes
Decennial Census - long form
- every 10 years, 10 questions

ACS
- began ~2005
- 3% of households surveyed
- estimate for the population: more questions, demos, etc.

1-year ACS: places > 65k. most current
3-year ACS: dead!
5-year ACS: block group and tract-level. each release is a 5-yr avg.

State -> County -> Tract (5-8k) -> Block Group (600 - 3k) -> Block


## Key Concepts
select() : choose columns
filter() : choose rows
mutate() : add column based on some data manipulation
arrange() : sort rows in asc or desc order
group_by() : narrow many rows down -> few groups based on shared traits
summarize() : descriptives + quick calcs
